_fiction_notice: Fictional finding register. No University of Iowa finding, service, measurement or team appears here.

findings.statement: 58% of sampled ESS change records carry a single approval.
RIS median deployment lead time moved from 6.1 days to 4.2 days across the sampled window.
IAM restoration time is not established: no restoration exercise is recorded in the supplied evidence.
2 of 9 sampled services have no recorded alert-routing owner.
The stated position that every service has a runbook is contradicted by the supplied inventory.
3 of 11 teams report an active AI-assisted workflow with a named output.

recommendations.statement: Record an approval owner for each change category.
Run one restoration exercise per tier-1 service and record the elapsed time.
Assign an alert-routing owner to the 2 services currently without one.
